SBC: Saudi Building Code — national building code family published by SBCNC
SBC201: SBC 201 — architectural provisions: occupancy, heights, areas, construction types
SBC301: SBC 301 — structural design and loading requirements
SBC501: SBC 501 — fire and life safety; primary technical basis for SCD review
SBC601: SBC 601 — energy conservation; envelope U-values, air leakage, thermal bridging
SBC701: SBC 701 — plumbing, sanitary drainage, and water efficiency
SBC801: SBC 801 — mechanical systems; HVAC, ventilation, and related building services
SBC1001: SBC 1001 — accessibility and universal design; MoMRAH audit focus area
A117.1: ICC A117.1 — Accessible and Usable Buildings and Facilities; technical criteria often referenced for SBC accessibility (use 2017 edition unless project specifies otherwise)
ICCA1171: ICC A117.1 shorthand — same as A117.1; Digital Codes id ICCA11712017P2 for the 2017 edition
SBCNC: Saudi Building Code National Committee — publishes and maintains SBC editions
SBPS: Saudi Building Permit System — centralized municipal building permit portal
BP: Building Permit — full construction authority approval via SBPS or special authority
OP: Outline / phased permit package — early or partial SBPS submission before full BP
PtC: Permit to Construct — construction-stage authority clearance after design lock
ChOO: Change of Occupancy — permit pathway when use class or intensity changes
SCD: Saudi Civil Defence — fire/life safety authority; NOC, inspections, Safety License
NOC: No Objection Certificate — authority clearance (SCD fire, utilities, landlord, etc.)
Safety License: SCD final operational license — issued after site inspection and IST closeout
AHJ: Authority Having Jurisdiction — Baladiya, SBPS, or special entity (NEOM, RSG, etc.)
Baladiya: Municipality — local building control alongside SBPS
MoMRAH: Ministry of Municipalities and Housing — national municipal and housing policy (also transliterated Momrah)
DMA: Dammam metropolitan municipality context — Eastern Province AHJ alongside Riyadh/Jeddah
Mostadam: KSA green building rating — mandatory on many government and giga-project assets
Is'har: Occupancy certificate — building occupation approval (Baladiya / SBPS pathway)
BCC: Building Completion Certificate — closeout documentation before occupancy
BUA: Built-up area — total constructed floor area relevant to code and zoning limits
GFA: Gross floor area — total floor area including common and service areas
FAR: Floor area ratio — plot intensity limit from masterplan or organizational survey
FFL: Finished floor level — datum aligned to road/sidewalk for drainage and access
Krooki: Organizational survey (Krooki Al-Tandhim) — plot dimensions, setbacks, coordinates
Sikka: Traditional alleyway / no-build corridor — setback and fire-access constraint on plots
FLS: Fire and Life Safety — strategy, drawings, and systems under SBC 501
IST: Integrated Systems Testing — commissioning test for fire, smoke, and alarm systems
C&E: Cause and effect matrix — fire alarm / smoke control logic; IST prerequisite
OFEC: Third-party fire consultant — often engaged for SCD technical review support
AOR: Architect of Record — stamped design responsibility on SBPS submissions
QSCP: Qualified Saudi consultant — locally licensed consultant required for SBPS portal acts
SCE: Saudi Council of Engineers — professional registration and practice governance
SASO: Saudi Standards, Metrology and Quality Organization — product conformity listing
SEC: Saudi Electricity Company — power supply NOC and connection for energization
NWC: National Water Company — potable water and sewerage NOC and connections
Golden Thread: Traceable compliance chain — design intent through MAR, IR, tests, and handover
MAR: Material Approval Request — submittal in Golden Thread quality pathway
IR: Inspection Request — site quality or authority inspection record
DCN: Design Change Notice — formal record for site or design deviation regularization
TPR: Third-party reviewer — independent technical review on giga-project or lender mandates
TOC: Taking-Over Certificate — contractual handover milestone (often FIDIC)
PC: Practical Completion — stage when works are substantially complete for handover
DLP: Defects Liability Period — post-handover defect remedy window under contract
FIDIC: International contract forms common on KSA projects — advisory interpretation only
VO: Variation Order — contract change affecting scope, cost, and often SBPS re-approval
EOT: Extension of Time — contractual programme relief claim
VE: Value engineering — cost optimization; must not erode SBC, SCD, or Mostadam basis
ER: Employer's Requirements — FIDIC design-build technical brief
BoQ: Bill of Quantities — measured works schedule in traditional procurement
DBB: Design-bid-build — traditional separated design and construction route
D&B: Design and build — single contractor design responsibility
EPC: Engineering, procurement, construction — turnkey delivery common on giga-projects
DfMA: Design for Manufacture and Assembly — modular and offsite delivery
MIC: Modular integrated construction — volumetric or panelized offsite systems
IFC: Issued for construction — coordinated drawing/spec set for site and authority
SD: Schematic design — early massing and code basis lock
DD: Design development — coordinated discipline design before IFC
CD: Construction documentation — tender and permit issue drawings and specs
BIM: Building information modeling — coordinated 3D/4D/5D project model
LOD: Level of development — BIM element reliability for coordination and quantities
MEP: Mechanical, electrical, and plumbing — building services disciplines
HVAC: Heating, ventilation, and air conditioning — dominant load in KSA climate
TR: Tons of refrigeration — chilled-water plant capacity unit common in Gulf specs
kVA: Kilovolt-ampere — electrical demand unit for SEC load and fit-out checks
SHGC: Solar heat gain coefficient — façade solar control metric under SBC 601
WWR: Window-to-wall ratio — envelope proportion driving cooling load and code limits
TSE: Treated sewage effluent — irrigation and non-potable reuse under water scarcity
NFPA: National Fire Protection Association — referenced alignment in SBC 501 practice
PI: Professional indemnity — consultant liability insurance for KSA/GCC commissions
SDR: Saudi local content — procurement and workforce nationalization requirements
SEZ: Special economic zone — bespoke building office (NEOM, RSG, etc.)
PIF: Public Investment Fund — sponsor context for Vision 2030 giga-projects
NEOM: Special economic zone — bespoke building office and design guidelines
RSG: Red Sea Global — coastal giga-project development authority
DGDA: Diriyah Gate Development Authority — heritage-adjacent masterplan authority
RCU: Royal Commission for AlUla — heritage and landscape-sensitive jurisdiction
RCJY: Royal Commission for Jubail and Yanbu — industrial city building control
RC: Royal Commission — jurisdiction in selected economic and heritage cities
Qiddiya: Entertainment giga-project — authority-specific design and permit regime
ROSHN: National housing developer — standardized residential delivery requirements
MODON: Saudi Authority for Industrial Cities and Technology Zones
KAFD: King Abdullah Financial District — distinct Riyadh planning and façade context
Soudah: Soudah Development — high-altitude resort authority in Asir region
GCC: Gulf Cooperation Council — regional practice context (KSA, UAE, Qatar, Oman, etc.)
DM: Dubai Municipality — UAE AHJ for mainland Dubai projects
DMT: Department of Municipalities and Transport — Abu Dhabi mainland AHJ
Estidama: Abu Dhabi sustainability rating — Pearl rating system for UAE capital projects
GSAS: Global Sustainability Assessment System — Qatar green building rating
Trakhees: Dubai free-zone building regulator — EHS and permit pathway outside DM core
LEED: Leadership in Energy and Environmental Design — optional rating alongside Mostadam
WELL: WELL Building Standard — health and wellness certification sometimes paired with LEED
ROW: Right of way — transport and utility corridor affecting plot and access
MV: Medium voltage — SEC supply tier affecting substation and easement design
LV: Low voltage — building distribution from SEC intake to tenant boards
Mashrabiya: Traditional screened façade — solar shading and privacy strategy in Gulf architecture
Ramadan: Fasting month — reduced site hours and authority processing in KSA programme
Hajj: Pilgrimage season — logistics and labour constraints affecting Western region sites
Vision 2030: KSA national transformation — driver of giga-projects and accelerated delivery
